Hitachi R-WB640VGV0 is a high-class 4-door Multi Door refrigerator line with a shiny black mirror monolithic glass surface, creating a trendy architectural highlight for modern apartment kitchens. The cabinet has a vacuum compartment Vacuum Compartment Exclusive: By removing air to reduce the pressure to 0.8 atmospheres, meat and fish foods will retain their freshness and nutrients throughout the week without freezing, saving defrosting time when cooking.

The independent dual-fan cooling system distributes cold air evenly throughout the compartments, completely preventing the mixing of food odors between the freezer and cool compartments.
